title: [Bug]: qos_sai_base.py test incorrect logic for single_dut_multi_asic cases on single-asic DUT
author: veronica-arista
body:
### Issue Description

The search for shortlink linecard logic added in PR https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/14925 does not verify that a DUT is multi-asic for the single_dut_multi_asic tests and incorrectly tries to access two asics on a single-asic DUT.

### Results you see

Running qos_sai_base.py `single_dut_multi_asic` test cases on a single-asic DUT will result in a `IndexError: list index out of range` error when trying to access an asic that doesn't exist.

### Results you expected to see

The `single_dut_multi_asic` test cases should be skipped on a single-asic DUT

### Is it platform specific

generic
